items.title: Square ball
items.flavour: Kotov is five metres away and facing the right direction.

outcomes.text: He takes it and gives it back. The game goes on being the game.
It is slightly behind him. He gets it under control and looks at you for a second.

items.title: Reset the move
items.flavour: Everything forward is closed and the goalkeeper is calling for it.

outcomes.text: You put it back to him. He kicks it long anyway.
You put it back and go again from the other side. It buys twenty seconds and a bit of air.

items.title: Chase the lost cause
items.flavour: It is going out for a goal kick and everybody knows it.

outcomes.text: You chase it anyway. The near side of the ground makes a small approving noise.
You chase it anyway. It goes out. You walk back with your hands on your hips.

items.title: The routine off the training ground
items.flavour: You have done this one nine times in the week and once it worked.

outcomes.text: It works. Nobody looks more surprised than the man who designed it.
The first ball is cut out. Everyone jogs back to their positions without comment.

items.title: The long stoppage
items.flavour: Their keeper is down and the physio is walking, not running.

outcomes.text: Three minutes standing on the halfway line. Your breathing comes back. So does theirs.
Three minutes standing on the halfway line. Whatever the team had going is gone by the restart.
